protocol.data: Train Session1 only; pseudo-target shift is temporal/subject holdout, not cross-session evidence
protocol.outer: 5-fold subject holdout; held-out subjects are unknown
protocol.known_outer_test: last 20% trials within each registered subject/task
protocol.inner: 2 pseudo-unknown groups; source first 60%, target registered 60–80% and pseudo-unknown first 80%
protocol.none: raw target features; exactly the full/base branches of the prior nested protocol
protocol.target_zscore: per-task unsupervised target feature mean/std mapped to source training mean/std; scale ratio clipped to [0.5, 2]
protocol.target_statistics: entire unlabeled inner/outer evaluation batch, including known and unknown trials; no identity/session labels
protocol.threshold: inner known confidence 5th percentile; outer labels never used for selection or calibration
protocol.aggregation: C/U/F1 pooled by trial; AUROC/AUPR/EER macro-averaged over outer folds

candidate.threshold_source: 5th percentile of all-subject source blocked-OOF known scores
candidate.target_alignment: all unlabeled test trials within each task; no session split
candidate.test_accuracy_claim: unknown; experimental candidate, formal answer untouched
